user_fields.description: These fields are returned, unmodified, in the user_fields section of the response.

Status.description: Reports the success or failure of the match attempt.

Status.Code.description: Reason for failure, if there is one.

Status.description.description: Specifies the description of the problem, if there is one.

AddressLine1.description: Specifies the first line of the validated and standardized address.

AddressLine2.description: Specifies the second line of the validated and standardized address.

StateProvince.description: Specifies the validated state or province abbreviation.

PostalCode.description: Specifies the validated ZIP Code or postal code.

Country.description: Specifies the country in the format determined by the selection from ISO or UPO or English.

FirmName.description: Specifies the validated firm or company name.

BlockAddress.description: Specifies the formatted address, as it would appear on a physical mail piece.

PostalCode.AddOn.description: Specifies the 4-digit add-on part of the ZIP Code.

AdditionalInputData.description: Specifies input data not used by the address validation process.

CouldNotValidate.description: Specifies the address component that could not be validated, in case no match is found.

AddressFormat.description: Specifies the type of address data being returned.

AddressLine3.description: Specifies the third line of the validated and standardized address. If the address could not be validated, the third line of the input address without any changes.

AddressLine4.description: Specifies the fourth line of the validated and standardized address. If the address could not be validated, the fourth line of the input address without any changes.

AddressRecord.Result.description: Specifies the result codes that apply to international addresses only.

ApartmentLabel.description: Specifies the apartment designator such as STE or APT.

ApartmentLabel.Input.description: Specifies the apartment designator such as STE or APT.

ApartmentLabel.Result.description: Specifies the result of apartment label.

ApartmentNumber.Result.description: Specifies the result of apartment number.

City.Result.description: Specifies the result of the validated city name.

Confidence.description: Specifies the the level of confidence assigned to the address being returned.

Country.Input.description: Specifies the name of the country.

Country.Result.description: Specifies the result code for the country.

CountryLevel.description: Specifies the category of address matching available.

FirmName.Input.description: Specifies the validated firm or company name.

FirmName.Result.description: Specifies if the firm name got validated.

HouseNumber.Result.description: Specifies the result for house number.

LeadingDirectional.Result.description: Specifies the result of leading directional.

MultipleMatches.description: Specifies the address component with multiple matches, if multiple matches were found:

POBox.description: Specifies the post office box number.

POBox.Input.description: Specifies the post office box number.

POBox.Result.description: Specifies the result of post office box number.

PostalCode.Input.description: Specifies the validated postal code. For U.S. addresses, this is the ZIP code.

PostalCode.Result.description: Specifies the result of validated postal code.

PostalCode.Type.description: Specifies the type of postal code returned.

PrivateMailbox.Type.description: Specifies the type of private mailbox.

PrivateMailbox.Type.Input.description: Specifies the type of private mailbox.

RecordType.description: Specifies the type of address record, as defined by U.S. and Canadian postal authorities.

RecordType.Default.description: Specifies the code indicating the default match.

RRHC.description: Specifies the Rural Route/Highway Contract indicator.

RRHC.Input.description: Specifies the Rural Route/Highway Contract indicator.

RRHC.Result.description: Specifies the result for Rural Route/Highway Contract indicator.

RRHC.Type.description: Specifies the result code for Rural Route/Highway Contract indicator.

StateProvince.Input.description: Specifies the validated state or province abbreviation.

StateProvince.Result.description: Specifies the result of validated state or province abbreviation.

Street.Result.description: Specifies the result codes for international addresses.

StreetName.Alias.Type.description: Specifies result code that applies to U.S. addresses only.

StreetName.Result.description: Specifies the result of the street name.

StreetNameAbbreviatedAlias.Result.description: Indicates the result of abbreviated alias processing.

StreetNamePreferredAlias.Result.description: Specifies the result of preferred alias processing.

StreetSuffix.Result.description: Specifies the result of the street suffix.

TrailingDirectional.Result.description: Specifies the result of the trailing directional.

MatchScore.description: Specifies an indication of the degree to which the output address is correct.

USLACS.description: Specifies whether the address is a candidate for LACS conversion. This is for U.S. addresses only).

USLACS.ReturnCode.description: Specifies the the success or failure of LACS processing. This is for U.S. addresses only).

RDI.description: Specifies the values indicating address type.

CMRA.description: Specifies if the address is a Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA).

DPV.description: Specifies the results of Delivery Point Validation (DPV) processing.

SuiteLinkReturnCode.description: Indicates whether or not API corrected the secondary address information (U.S. addresses only).

SuiteLinkMatchCode.description: Provides additional information on the SuiteLink match attempt. (U.S. addresses only)

SuiteLinkFidelity.description: Indicates how well ValidateAddress matched the firm name to the firm names in the SuiteLink database.

USBCCheckDigit.description: Specifies the check-digit portion of the 11-digit delivery point barcode.

PostalBarCode.description: Specifies the delivery point portion of the delivery point barcode.

USFIPSCountyNumber.description: Specifies FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) county number (U.S. addresses only).

USCountyName.description: Specifies the county name (U.S. addresses only).

USAltAddr.description: Specifies whether the alternate address matching logic was used, and if so which logic was used (U.S. addresses only).

USLastLineNumber.description: Specifies a six-character alphanumeric value that groups together ZIP Codes that share the same primary city.

USFinanceNumber.description: Specifies the finance number in which the address resides (U.S. addresses only).

USUrbanName.description: U.S. address urbanization name. Used primarily for Puerto Rico addresses.

USUrbanName.Input.description: U.S. address urbanization name. Used primarily for Puerto Rico addresses.

USUrbanName.Result.description: U.S. address urbanization name. Used primarily for Puerto Rico addresses.

MultimatchCount.description: If the address was matched to multiple candidate addresses in the reference data, this field contains the number of candidate matches found.

CanLanguage.description: Specifies whether the address is in English or French. This is for Canadian address only.

DPVNoStat.description: Specifies whether the building is a no stat building and therefore unable to receive mail.

DPVVacant.description: Specifies whether the building is vacant, unoccupied for 90 days.
